title: Every fixed rule loads and the sort covers the whole list
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} has more than 1,000 fixed rules (for example 2,000), as the largest shop has 8,994.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC47 cat) exists.
  • Fixed rule part {Part-A} (for example zzzz-ZZAUTOTEST-PC47-last) is at {Location-A} in {Category-A} with the highest fixed price at the location (for example 999999.00). Its part number comes after every other fixed rule's part number.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Look at the rows shown without scrolling.
  5. Click the Fixed Price column header.
  6. Read the first row.
  7. Click the Fixed Price column header again.
  8. Scroll to the end of the list.
  9. Read the last row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: {Part-A} is not among the rows shown, because its part number puts it at the far end.
  • Step 6: straight after the click, without any scrolling, the first row is {Part-A}, the highest price. The sort reached a rule that was far down the list, without any further loading.
  • Steps 8 and 9: no loading indicator appears while you scroll, and the last row is {Part-A} (lowest first now, so the highest price is last).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R13, S3-R14 (with S3-R8, S3-R9), §6 Assumptions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), first comment item 4: QA tests at production volumes. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists). The technical plan of 13 Oct 2026 (FR-018, FR-020) says the first click on Fixed price sorts lowest first; PRD version 21 (14 Oct 2026, S3-R4, S3-R8) says highest first and is newer, so this case follows the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R13: “Every fixed rule the tab lists (S3-R12b) loads when the tab opens.”
  • S3-R14: “The sort covers every fixed rule, not only the rules already visible on screen.”
  • S3-R8: “Fixed price sorts by value. Its first click puts the highest price first.”
  • S3-R9: “The second click on Fixed price puts the lowest price first.”
  • PRD §6 Assumptions: “QA tests every list at these sizes, on the largest organization, and not only on a small shop.”
  • SV-10136 acceptance criteria: “Given a shop with more fixed rules than one page, then the sort covers every rule and not only the ones fetched so far.”
